district.description: District: for Pattaya the tourist district from coordinates (Naklua & Wongamat, North, Central and South Pattaya, Pratumnak, Jomtien, Na Jomtien, Bang Saray, East Pattaya); elsewhere the subdistrict.

projects.description: Projects with listings in the district.

saleListings.description: Listings for sale (duplicates across agencies included).

medianSalePricePerSqm.description: Typical asking price per m² (median of sale listings, obvious typos left out), in THB.

salePricePerSqmLow.description: Lower quartile of asking prices per m²: a quarter of listings ask less.

salePricePerSqmHigh.description: Upper quartile of asking prices per m²: a quarter of listings ask more.

medianSalePrice.description: Typical asking price of a unit for sale, in THB.

medianSaleSizeSqm.description: Typical size of a unit for sale, in m².

medianRentPerSqm.description: Typical monthly rent per m², in THB.

grossYieldPercent.description: Gross yield: 12 months of the typical rent per m² against the typical asking price per m², in percent. Needs at least 3 sale and 3 rent listings. Before costs, vacancy and the discount from asking to sale price.

newSinceLastRun.description: Listings that were not there in the last run with the same memory name.

priceCutsSinceLastRun.description: Listings whose price went down since the last run.

medianDaysListed.description: Typical days since the listing was first seen or posted.

removedSinceLastRun.description: Listings seen in the last run and gone in this one: most were sold, rented or taken off the market.

segment.description: all: the whole district; resale: listings in completed projects older than about two years; new & off plan: projects under construction or completed in the last two years.
